description: This file is a PHP source file defining a class 'Analytics' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension'. It contains methods for managing analytics extensions in the OpenCart admin system, including listing, installing, and uninstalling analytics extensions.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: Controller class for managing analytics extensions in the admin panel, including listing, installing, and uninstalling analytics modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that outputs the list of analytics extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML view containing the list of available, installed, and enabled analytics extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a new analytics extension, including permission checks and registering the extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of an analytics extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
